name: dcp
description: Dynamic context pruning: the model compresses closed conversation ranges into summaries; the session is forked and switched to apply them

maxContextLimit.title: Max context limit
maxContextLimit.description: Tokens (e.g. 150000) or a percent of the model window (e.g. 75%) above which the end-of-turn prompt is very aggressive and the emergency nudge is sent

minContextLimit.title: Min context limit
minContextLimit.description: Tokens (e.g. 100000) or a percent of the model window (e.g. 50%) below which the end-of-turn prompt only drops, and summaries are limited to stubs

nudgeFrequency.title: Nudge frequency
nudgeFrequency.description: Tool results between repeated emergency nudges

summaryBuffer.title: Summary buffer
summaryBuffer.description: Raise the max context limit by the tokens the active summaries hold

protectedTools.title: Protected tools
protectedTools.description: Tool names whose outputs are kept verbatim in compression summaries (globs allowed)

protectedFilePatterns.title: Protected file patterns
protectedFilePatterns.description: Globs; tool calls touching matching files are protected from dedup, purge and compression

protectUserMessages.title: Protect user messages
protectUserMessages.description: Keep user messages verbatim inside compression summaries

protectTags.title: Protect <protect> tags
protectTags.description: Keep <protect>...</protect> prompt text verbatim inside compression summaries

deduplication.title: Deduplication
deduplication.description: Prune older tool calls with identical tool and arguments when compressing

purgeErrors.title: Purge errors
purgeErrors.description: Prune inputs of old failed tool calls when compressing

purgeErrorsTurns.title: Purge errors after turns
purgeErrorsTurns.description: Assistant turns a failed call must be old before its input is pruned
